$schema_note: Local-build Hyprland plugin manifest. Edit this file when you add or retire a plugin. Both ~/bin/hypr-doctor (via jq) and Claude (via Read) consume this as the source of truth.

plugins.name: hyprtasking
plugins.build_cmd: rm -rf build && meson setup build --buildtype=release && ninja -C build
plugins.notes: Local fork carrying workspace-layout / multi-monitor / lifecycle / drop-target fixes. Sync upstream via `git cherry-pick origin/main`, never rebase (LAYERS feature divergence).

plugins.name: dynamic-cursors
plugins.build_cmd: make clean && rm -rf out && make all
plugins.notes: Upstream is VirtCode/hypr-dynamic-cursors (origin), NOT raybbian — fix any docs that say otherwise. Tracked as detached-HEAD on a hyprpm.toml pin. After a Hyprland update: `git -C /home/komi/repos/dynamic-cursors fetch origin && git show origin/main:hyprpm.toml` (left col = Hyprland commit, right col = plugin commit to build), `git checkout <plugin-commit>`, then rebuild. Re-enabled 2026-06-15 for Hyprland 0.55.4 → pin da447486c84e0be81f2cdd208af1ef92469f0a88.

$watched_venvs_note: Project dirs containing a .venv whose interpreter health hypr-doctor checks. Catches the 'python got bumped / repo moved → venv orphaned' class (e.g. ccx broke this way on 2026-05-30 when its repo moved to claude-dirs). Each entry is a project dir; the check runs <dir>/.venv/bin/python --version and, on failure, prints the recreate recipe.

suppressions.$note: Acknowledged drift that should stay SILENT in the SessionStart hook (it still appears in full `audit`, marked acknowledged, and does not count toward the issue total). Self-expiring: the ack matches only the exact recorded version pair, so any package bump revives the warning. Set the current pair with `hypr-doctor ack-skew`.

qt_python_bindings.$note: Packages that must stay version-locked to qt6-base. When qt6-base bumps and these don't, anything Python+Qt will fail at runtime with 'no Qt platform plugin can be initialized'.

stack_packages.$note: Packages whose upgrade triggers a hypr-doctor recommendation in the SessionStart hook.
